certification_rule_applied: Plant certification = one the plant/company holds (AISC, ISO, CWB/CSA W47.1 company certification, state DOT, AWS Certified Welding Fabricator). Welders certified/qualified to AWS D1.1/D1.5, CWIs, or work to the D1.1 code are shown only labelled '(personnel)' or 'code, not a certification'; where nothing else is held the field reads 'unknown (...)' as for DIS-TRAN and Cem-Tec. Applied: Millerbernd, Nello South Bend (dropped unsupported AWS/CWI, AISC from snapshot); Valmont Tulsa and Claremore (now 'unknown (welder qualification ...)'); LaX Spring Grove and Westby CWI labelled; Maico, PennFab, DiHighway, Arcosa Telecom Muskogee, Universal, V&S Canton, Metal Pros (personnel labels). AISC only from a company statement or a snapshot row naming the plant.
